name: Raider’s Eyepatch
body:
Price 4,500 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 3; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This simple leather eyepatch does not hamper the wearer’s vision in any way. If worn over the left eye you gain the benefits of the Blind Fight feat. If worn over the right eye it can be activated as a swift action to grant you see invisibility as the spell for 3 rounds. This ability functions twice per day. Switching which eye the patch is covering is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, see invisibility
